mainEntity.name: What permits are required for a bathroom addition in cities like Pacifica or Daly City?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a bathroom in Pacifica, Daly City, or other Bay Area municipalities typically requires several permits. These usually include building permits for structural changes, plumbing permits for new water and waste lines, and electrical permits for new wiring and fixtures. Depending on the scope, mechanical permits might also be needed.
